description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEE_Alert" name="OEE below threshold alert"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE_Process" name="OEE monitoring" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OEE_Alert"
                      name="OEE alert email"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendEmail"
                      targetRef="Participant_Engineer"
                      messageRef="Message_OEE_Alert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Start monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect machine information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckOEE" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEE_NotBelow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Message_OEE_Alert"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">machineRestarted</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">machineDisconnected</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_To_Stop" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_To_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_To_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">OEE < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_NotBelow" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_To_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_To_Restart" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_To_Collect" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
